offering_description.value: Gartner provides research, advisory services, and conferences for enterprise executives and their teams. Its analysts and executive partners use proprietary data and subject expertise to guide decisions, and its events bring leaders together with analysts and peers.

quotes.quote: Gartner analysts deliver C-Level insights backed by proprietary data and deep subject matter expertise. Deeply immersed in a full range of topics, from AI strategies to operating decisions, our analysts work hand in hand with Executive Partners to proactively guide leaders to achieve their mission-critical priorities over time. Deeply experienced former practitioners, they’re here to help you move faster and achieve real results.
Experience the ultimate combination of analyst guidance, unrivaled peer networking and exclusive insights into the trends, challenges and opportunities facing your role.

primary_products.value: Written research; technology market and vendor evaluation tools

quotes.quote: With 80K+ business executives and 6K+ written insights, Gartner delivers a unique intelligence advantage.
Understand fast-moving markets, evaluate vendors and make key decisions.
